# Create the transform function
def transform(grid):
    """Transform: Identify full rows/cols and mark with 2s"""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    # Find background value (most common)
    from collections import Counter
    all_vals = [cell for row in grid for cell in row]
    background = Counter(all_vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    
    # Create a mask for which cells should become 2
    mark = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    
    # Mark full rows
    for r in range(h):
        row = grid[r]
        non_bg = [v for v in row if v != background]
        if non_bg and all(v == non_bg[0] for v in non_bg):
            for c in range(w):
                mark[r][c] = True
    
    # Mark full columns
    for c in range(w):
        non_bg = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != background]
        if non_bg and all(v == non_bg[0] for v in non_bg):
            for r in range(h):
                mark[r][c] = True
    
    # Apply transformation
    output = [[grid[r][c] if not mark[r][c] else 2 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
